text.tspan: Weighted, failover and latency routing in pictures
Weights need not add to 100. Max 100 weighted
records with the same name and type.
Weight 0 = no traffic (used only if every
nonzero record is unhealthy); all 0 = equal.
secondary record. Give the primary a health check
(or Evaluate Target Health on an alias); without it
Route 53 assumes it is healthy and never fails over.
Works in private hosted zones too.
Latency: Route 53 picks the Region with the
lowest measured latency between the user and AWS
Regions, not the nearest one. A German user can
get a US Region. Latency data changes over time.
